name: Cottage court / pocket neighborhood
summary: Small detached cottages (typically 500-1,100 SF, 1-1.5 stories) around a shared green. Cost behaves like small single-family construction - high $/SF because kitchens, baths and envelope don't shrink with floor area - plus shared courtyard, walks, parking and individual utility services. No published cottage-court construction budget was retrieved; the default is derived from Census single-family contract prices and NAHB cost-share data with a small-home premium. Confidence low-medium.

typicalSize.method: Missing Middle Housing typical spec is 5-10 units per cottage court lot (k1); larger pocket neighborhoods combine two courts (high 16).

sfPerPrimaryUnit.method: Missing Middle typical unit size 500-800 SF (k1); market-rate pocket neighborhoods commonly add lofts/second floors at the rear (1-1.5 stories, rear building sometimes 2), so mid set at 850 SF gross and high 1,100.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Missing Middle gross density 10-20 du/acre front-loaded and 15-31 du/acre alley-loaded (k1); mid 16 = blend.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Missing Middle parking ratio '1-2 per unit', off-street '1 per unit max.' (k1).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Base: Census 2025 median contract price for contractor-built single-family homes $404,000 (k2) / median completed home size 2,142 SF (k2) = ~$189/SF (sizes are for all completed homes, so approximate). Contract price excludes land and is a builder price incl. OH&P. Small-home premium: fixed-cost kitchen/bath/MEP spread over ~850 SF instead of ~2,100 SF -> x1.35 = ~$255/SF. Shared cottage-court site work (green, walks, shared parking, individual utility services) adds ~$30k/unit (~$35/SF) beyond the ~7.6% site work in a typical single-family build (k3). Mid = 850 SF x ~$290/SF = ~$245k. Low = 600 SF economy/modular (~$235/SF); high = 1,100 SF premium in a high-cost market (~$380/SF).

perSF.method: See perPrimaryUnit method: $189/SF Census-derived base x small-home premium (1.1-1.6) + shared site work ($20-$45/SF).

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. general conditions and OH&P, including on-site utilities, shared green, walks, surface parking and landscaping. Excludes land, soft costs, off-site improvements, impact/tap fees and financing. Appliances included (Div 11).

qualityTiers.method: From the $/SF range: low/mid = 210/290 = 0.72 tempered to 0.8; high/mid = 420/290 = 1.45 for premium/luxury spread.

systemSplit.method: Mapped from NAHB 2024 construction-cost stages (k3): site work 7.6%, foundations 10.5%, framing 16.6%, exterior finishes 13.4%, major system rough-ins 19.2%, interior finishes 24.1%, final steps 6.5%, other 2.1%. Foundations -> 03; framing -> 06; exterior -> 07/08; rough-ins -> 22/23/26; interior finishes -> 09/12/11/06 trim; final steps -> 32 landscaping/driveways. Site/utilities raised from 7.6% to ~19% (31+32+33) for the shared green, walks, parking and individual utility runs; general conditions 7% added (NAHB stages exclude builder overhead).

lineItems.name: Shared courtyard green, walks, lighting and landscaping

cost.method: Judgment: ~4,000-8,000 SF central green at $15-$35/SF incl. walks, pedestrian lighting, planting and irrigation.

lineItems.name: Individual water, sewer and electric services per cottage

cost.method: Judgment: on-site laterals and meter sets for detached units on a shared lot; excludes tap/impact fees.

lineItems.notes: Carve-out. Some jurisdictions allow a single master meter.

lineItems.name: Common house (shared kitchen/gathering room, 600-1,200 SF)

cost.method: 600-1,200 SF at the cottage $/SF range (~$250-$375/SF). Judgment.

lineItems.notes: Typical of pocket neighborhoods / cohousing, rare in small infill courts.

lineItems.name: Shared carport / detached garage structure

cost.method: Judgment: open carport (low) to enclosed detached garage bay (high).

lineItems.notes: Surface parking is in baseline; covered parking optional.

lineItems.name: NFPA 13D residential sprinklers (where fire access requires)

cost.method: Judgment for 13D systems in small dwellings; often triggered when cottages exceed fire-access distance from the street.

lineItems.notes: Per SF of cottage floor area.

perPrimaryUnit.method: For-sale/long-term rental cottages are unfurnished (appliances are in hard cost). High applies if furnished as rentals.

pctOfHard.method: Small infill projects carry design, survey, civil, permits, subdivision/condo mapping and legal over few units. NAHB 2024: builder overhead/general expenses 5.7% and marketing 0.8% of price vs. construction 64.4% (k4) = ~10% of construction just for overhead/marketing; plus A&E ~7% and permits/legal ~3-5%. Mid 20%.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min = low hard $140k + 10% soft; max = high hard $420k + 28% soft + contingency headroom for coastal metros.

evidence.quote: Typical Specifications: Number of units 5-10; Typical unit size 500-800 sq. ft.; Density (gross) 10-20 du/acre front-loaded, 15-31 du/acre alley-loaded; Parking ratio 1-2 per unit
evidence.scopeNotes: Also: lot area 11,500-24,000 SF front-loaded / 10,000-22,500 SF alley-loaded; net density 13-38 / 19-44 du/acre; 1-1.5 stories (rear-most building sometimes 2). No cost data.

source.title: Highlights of 2025 Characteristics of New Housing

evidence.quote: The median contract price was $404,000. ... The median size of a completed single-family home was 2,142 square feet.
evidence.scopeNotes: Contract price applies to contractor-built homes started in 2025 (on the owner's land, excludes land); the 2,142 SF median is for all completed single-family homes, so $/SF (~$189) is approximate.

source.title: Cost of Constructing a Home in 2024

evidence.quote: Construction costs account for 64.4% of the average price of a home.
evidence.scopeNotes: Stage shares of construction cost: interior finishes 24.1%, major system rough-ins 19.2%, framing 16.6%, exterior finishes 13.4%, foundations 10.5%, site work 7.6%, final steps 6.5%, other 2.1%. Dated Jan 23, 2025.

source.title: Cost of Constructing a Home in 2024

evidence.quote: Construction costs account for 64.4% of the average price of a home.
evidence.scopeNotes: Other shares of sales price reported in the same post: finished lot 13.7%, builder profit 11.0%, overhead and general expenses 5.7%, sales commission 2.8%, financing 1.5%, marketing 0.8%. Value = overhead share.

openQuestions: No actual cottage-court construction budget was retrieved (web search budget exhausted). Candidates: Sightline Institute cottage cluster cost studies, Ross Chapin pocket neighborhood pro formas, Habitat for Humanity cottage communities, city pre-approved cottage plan programs.
Small-home $/SF premium (x1.35) is judgment; verify against RSMeans small residential models.
NAHB stage shares are for a typical (much larger) single-family home; verify for sub-1,000 SF cottages.
